name: Collapsing Threads
note: A conversation reader whose middle messages fold into a pill that unfolds with a staggered 0fr-to-1fr grid-row transition, and whose subject condenses on a scroll() timeline inside its own scroller. Set --apm-convo-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Chip Composer
note: Recipient chips with a listbox autocomplete, paste splitting and drag between To/Cc/Bcc, a contenteditable body with synced toolbar state, and an undo-send ring drawn by an @property conic gradient. Set --apm-compose-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Split Inbox
note: Priority lanes fed by a sender screener; cards are dragged with pointer capture and a velocity-tilted ghost, moves become routing rules, and lane changes animate with FLIP. Set --apm-split-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Operator Search
note: A search field with a syntax-highlighted mirror layer that tokenizes from:, has:, before: and negation, context-aware autocomplete, facets counted from the live result set and saved searches with live counts. Set --apm-query-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Swipe Triage
note: Pointer-driven swipe rows with threshold snaps for archive, snooze and delete, a snooze timeline you can scrub forward so mail returns, and an inbox-zero ring animated through @property. Set --apm-swipe-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Newsletter Digest
note: Newsletters bundled into one edition: cards rise on a view() timeline, the reader tracks progress on a scroll() timeline with a JS fallback, and unsubscribing re-flows the edition with undo. Set --apm-digest-h to 100dvh in an app.
